fusions.name: Thump Warning
fusions.desc: Every enemy within 2.5 tiles takes 4 damage. For 3 seconds after using it, you move 20% faster.

fusions.name: Bolt Through
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and strike it for 14 damage, hitting harder the further it travels, up to 1.5 times its damage at maximum range.

fusions.name: Slipped Snare
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 control conditions from you. Your movement speed rises 30% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Frightened Feet
fusions.desc: Every 6 tiles you cover, a shield worth 15% of your maximum health closes over you for 4 seconds. Once every 5 seconds.
